author: libertedeparole
text:
"We simply cannot sell the assets, they have to be given to another charity if the Foundation ever dissolves."

This is a good measure.

However, can the organization sell or transfer any of its assets during normal operation? Can it, for example, sell an unneeded older computer that has been replaced? Can it, for example, sell or "rent" its database of members?

Please understand that no accusations are being made here.

author: Mikael
text:
Hey Libertedeparole,

Our by-laws (articles of association) specifically prohibit selling or transferring the users database (3.1.12), during or after operations.

All our software is open source; nothing is stopping any entity to set it up somewhere, but that's pretty worthless without members.

Thanks for asking!
